name: 4-Day Machine-Based Split
description: Muscle group focus, knee-conscious legs, 90-min cap.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine (flat)
exercises.notes_md: Adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest. Don't fully lock elbows.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press Machine
exercises.notes_md: Hits upper chest — the part that builds the 'shelf' under your collarbone.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Machine (Chest Fly)
exercises.notes_md: Slow squeeze in the middle, controlled return.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover (high-to-low)
exercises.notes_md: Different angle hits the lower chest. The one cable lift you'll want here.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown Machine
exercises.notes_md: Elbows pinned to your sides, no swinging. (Cable rope works if no machine.)

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Tricep Extension Machine
exercises.notes_md: Hits the long head — the part that gives arms thickness.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip Machine
exercises.notes_md: AMRAP — as many reps as possible with good form. Lean slightly forward = chest, stay upright = triceps.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (wide grip)
exercises.notes_md: Pull bar to upper chest, lean back ~10°. Don't pull behind your neck.

exercises.name: Seated Row Machine
exercises.notes_md: Squeeze shoulder blades together at the end. (Cable row works.)

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-up Machine
exercises.notes_md: Build toward unassisted pull-ups over time — huge for back width.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (close/neutral grip)
exercises.notes_md: Different grip hits lower lats.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck (Rear Delt Fly)
exercises.notes_md: Rear delts and upper back — fixes hunched posture.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl Machine
exercises.notes_md: Strict form, no momentum.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl Machine (seated)
exercises.notes_md: Two curl variations is fine — biceps recover fast.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.notes_md: **Don't go super deep with the left knee.** Find a depth that's pain-free, even if higher than the right side.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes_md: **Moderate weight only.** Slow, controlled, no kicking the weight up. Bad knee = light, slow.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes_md: **Extra set** — strong hamstrings = ACL protection. Don't skip.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.notes_md: Different hamstring angle. (Glute Drive Machine works if available.)

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.notes_md: Outer glutes — burns the love-handle area indirectly + stabilizes the knee.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
exercises.notes_md: Inner thighs — often weak in big guys, helps with knee tracking.

exercises.name: Standing or Seated Calf Raise Machine
exercises.notes_md: Slow eccentric, full stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine
exercises.notes_md: Adjust seat so handles start at ear height. Don't lock out hard.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise Machine
exercises.notes_md: Best machine for shoulder width. (Cable lateral raise works as fallback.)

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck (rear delts)
exercises.notes_md: Yes, again from Tuesday. Rear delts can take the volume.

exercises.name: Cable or Machine Front Raise
exercises.notes_md: Most people overdevelop side delts and skip front — keep it balanced.

exercises.name: Shrug Machine
exercises.notes_md: Traps — adds the 'filled out' look to your upper body. (DB shrugs as fallback.)

exercises.name: Ab Crunch Machine
exercises.notes_md: Direct ab work with resistance.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair / Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.notes_md: Lower abs — the area you care about.

exercises.name: Back Extension Machine (Roman Chair)
exercises.notes_md: Lower back balance — important for posture and to balance all the ab work.
